purpose: Bind research-verified professional editorial responsibilities, narrative-consistency regression, later-stage regression control and research-before-implementation law into the Book System parent lifecycle while reusing current Creative Excellence, Prose and Book Evaluator authorities and preserving exact-SHA-qualified parent foundations.

compatibility_strategy.qualification_claim: PASS on its original exact subject only
compatibility_strategy.rule: This amendment does not claim the existing transition engine executable runtime already enforces newly named editorial substage gates. New requirements are expressed as parent lifecycle evidence overlays within existing top-level project states until a separately versioned executable transition-model successor is justified and qualified.

top_level_project_state_compatibility.reason: The research requires distinct editorial responsibility gates, but it does not require replacing already-qualified parent top-level state vocabulary merely to name those responsibilities.

canonical_editorial_flow.applicability_rule: Stages are capability/responsibility gates, not a rigid universal process. Their depth, iteration and applicability are conditioned by book form, genre, audience, governing brief, target medium, revision scope and author intent. A stage may be marked NOT_APPLICABLE only with recorded rationale and no unresolved required evidence for that scope.
canonical_editorial_flow.iteration_rule: A later stage may route a discovered upstream defect back to the correct earlier stage, but may not silently broaden its own mutation scope.
canonical_editorial_flow.author_rule: AUTHOR_REVIEW remains a parent checkpoint and bounded AUTHOR_DECISION objects may also be required inside any stage when canon, intent, protected language, subjective gain, publication or other configured author authority is implicated.

primary_service_authorities: Prose Narrative State and Narrative Orchestration
Prose book-level intelligence and relevant granular specialists
hard_rules: No second structural editor engine is authorized.
Whole-book or macro findings are evidence/proposals until Book System admission.
Accepted structural changes that affect dependencies must propagate invalidation through the parent lifecycle ledger.

primary_service_authorities: Prose Passage Intelligence / Step-F diagnostics / Craft Academy
Book Evaluator surface/revision evidence where applicable
hard_rules: No second line/prose editor engine is authorized.
Retain original on tied, low-confidence or preservation-unsafe evidence.
A polished change is not accepted merely because a model prefers it.

primary_service_authorities: Book Evaluator surface-language / fact-source / continuity evidence
Book System parent copy-edit profile and versioned style sheet
COPY_EDIT_REVIEW.correction_boundary: Copy editing may correct mechanics, consistency and bounded factual/reference defects under the configured style sheet. Any change that materially alters structure, meaning, voice, canon, protected language or subjective literary effect must route back to the appropriate line/structural or author-decision boundary.
hard_rules: No generic replacement literary editor is authorized.
Project/book style sheet is versioned parent evidence, not an implicit model preference.
Ambiguous or voice-sensitive changes require review rather than automatic normalization.
Proofing runs against the exact rendered/export candidate, not only manuscript source text.
Proof corrections are bounded; an upstream structural/line issue must be routed back rather than silently rewritten during proof.
Proof PASS does not grant publication authorization.

narrative_consistency_regression.required_when: Any accepted structural, line/stylistic or semantically material copy-edit change can affect narrative dependencies or parent canon/story-bible state.
narrative_consistency_regression.existing_engine_binding: BOOK-SYSTEM-LIFECYCLE-TRANSITION-ENGINE-001 invalidation propagation and stale-service-response rules remain the parent mechanism for downstream invalidation.
narrative_consistency_regression.acceptance_rule: No affected canonical revision may be admitted while a critical consistency regression is unresolved unless an explicitly authorized parent/author waiver type exists for that exact gate; absence of evidence is not a pass.
narrative_consistency_regression.restoration_rule: An invalidated unit may restore only after current-version revalidation under the existing transition engine contract.

later_stage_regression_law.rule: Every later editorial/production stage must verify accepted prior-stage changes are present in the exact current manuscript/rendered identity and must check for defects introduced by its own changes.
later_stage_regression_law.upstream_defect_discovery: Finding an upstream problem creates a routed review/reopen request for the appropriate earlier stage; it does not silently expand later-stage edit authority.
later_stage_regression_law.stage_skip: A recorded NOT_APPLICABLE disposition must state why the stage is not required for the current form/scope/medium and cannot be used to bypass unresolved evidence.

research_before_implementation_law.scope: Major Book System architecture or capability additions
research_before_implementation_law.exception: Strict repair of already-qualified behavior with no new capability or authority expansion.
research_before_implementation_law.evidence_rule: No single vendor, model, popularity signal or isolated source is sufficient architectural authority.
research_before_implementation_law.routing_rule: A major unverified capability addition is RESEARCH_GATE_REQUIRED, not implementation-ready.

implementation_effect.reason: Publication/export standards and provenance interoperability remain research-remediation successors, followed by a contract re-review.

required_follow_on_runtime_compatibility.when: Before any executable runtime is claimed to enforce these new editorial substage gates
required_follow_on_runtime_compatibility.question: Can required evidence overlays be enforced through existing versioned interfaces without changing the qualified transition model, or is a BOOK-SYSTEM-LIFECYCLE-TRANSITION-ENGINE-002 successor required?
required_follow_on_runtime_compatibility.rule: If executable state/gate semantics change, create and qualify a versioned successor; never relabel v1 evidence as covering v2 behavior.

next_objective_contract: Define target-medium publication/export profiles, including EPUB 3.3 and accessibility when applicable, ONIX 3.1-compatible metadata projection when distribution metadata is needed, PDF/DOCX/print/EPUB-specific proof obligations, exact frozen-manuscript-to-render digest binding, and a fail-closed boundary between technical export/proof and publication authorization.
qualification_effect: NONE. This amendment is parent architecture/control law only and does not transfer or broaden exact-SHA A-01 qualification, human/editor evidence, author approval, manuscript promotion or publication authority.
